usage: As a noun, 點 is used to count hours when telling time.
You can say the exact hour by mentioning the number followed by 點, like 5點 for 5 o'clock.
It can be paired with 分 (minutes) to specify the time more precisely, for example 3點15分.
In casual speech, people often use 點 to ask or talk about the current time.
點 is typically placed after the number to indicate the hour, never before.
